bulk_run_robot.description: Run one robot over many sets of input parameters at once, a list of pages to scrape, for example. Browse AI queues one task per entry (up to 50,000) and returns a bulk run ID; read the results with 'List tasks' filtered by that ID.
bulk_run_robot.display_str_template: Bulk run the Browse AI robot '{0}'.
bulk_run_robot.name: bulk_run_robot

parameters.description: The ID of the robot to use (the UUID in the address bar when you open the robot on the Browse AI dashboard, or an 'id' returned by 'List robots').
parameters.name: robot_id

parameters.description: A list of input parameter objects, one per task, for example [{"originUrl": "https://example.com/a"}, {"originUrl": "https://example.com/b"}].
parameters.name: input_parameters

items.description: One task's input parameters, keyed by the robot's parameter names.

parameters.description: A name for the bulk run, shown on the Browse AI dashboard. Up to 200 characters.
parameters.name: title

created_at.description: When the bulk run was created, as a Unix timestamp in ms.

failed_tasks.description: How many of those tasks have failed.

id.description: The bulk run's ID. Pass it to 'List tasks' as the bulk run ID to read the results.

robot_id.description: ID of the robot running the tasks.

status.description: How the bulk run as a whole is doing.

successful_tasks.description: How many of those tasks have succeeded.

tasks_count.description: How many tasks the bulk run queued.

title.description: The bulk run's title, if one was given.

get_task.description: Fetch one of a robot's tasks by ID, including everything it captured: text fields, list tables, and screenshots. Poll this after 'Run robot' until 'is_finished' is true.
get_task.name: get_task

parameters.description: The ID of the robot to use (the UUID in the address bar when you open the robot on the Browse AI dashboard, or an 'id' returned by 'List robots').
parameters.name: robot_id

parameters.description: The ID of the task (the 'id' returned by 'Run robot' or 'List tasks').
parameters.name: task_id

bulk_run_id.description: ID of the bulk run this task belongs to, if any.

captured_data_url.description: Temporary link to the full captured data as JSON, for results too large to inline.

captured_lists.description: The tables the robot captured, keyed by list name. Each value is an array of row objects.

captured_screenshots.description: The screenshots the robot captured, keyed by screenshot name, each with a temporary 'src' link and its dimensions.

captured_texts.description: The single values the robot captured, keyed by the field name given in the recorder, for example {'Product Name': 'Alexis'}.

created_at.description: When the task was created, as a Unix timestamp in ms.

error.description: Why the task failed, or null if it did not fail.

finished_at.description: When the task finished, as a Unix timestamp in ms.

input_parameters.description: The input parameters the robot ran with.

is_finished.description: True once the task is successful or failed. False while the robot is still working; poll 'Get task' until it turns true.

retried_by_task_id.description: ID of the task that retried this one, if any.

retried_original_task_id.description: ID of the task this one is a retry of, if any.

robot_id.description: ID of the robot that ran the task.

run_by_api.description: Whether the task was started through the API.

run_by_monitor_id.description: ID of the monitor that started the task, if one did.

run_by_user_id.description: ID of the user who started the task, if a person did.

started_at.description: When the task started, as a Unix timestamp in ms.

status.description: One of in-progress, successful, or failed.

video_url.description: Temporary link to the session recording, when one was made.

list_robots.description: List the robots on your Browse AI account, each with the input parameters it accepts: the starting point for finding a robot's ID and what to pass it.
list_robots.name: list_robots

created_at.description: When the robot was created, as a Unix timestamp in ms.

input_parameters.description: The input parameters the robot accepts.

default_value.description: What the robot uses when the parameter is left out.

encrypted.description: Whether the value is stored encrypted, e.g. a password.

name.description: Key to pass the value under.

total_count.description: How many robots the account has.

list_tasks.description: List a robot's tasks with the data each one captured. Filter by status to pick up only successful runs, or by bulk run ID to collect the results of a bulk run.
list_tasks.display_str_template: List the tasks of the Browse AI robot '{0}'.
list_tasks.name: list_tasks

run_robot.description: Run a Browse AI robot once: it opens a real browser, follows the steps it was trained on, and extracts the data you recorded.
